name: Panta OEM Diagnostics Expansion 4
usage_note: Curated OEM-derived diagnostic guidance. Preserve exact applicability and verify VIN, engine configuration, software level and current OEM procedure before repair.

documents.title: Detroit hard start/no start diagnostic path — two-filter fuel system
documents.source: NHTSA archived Detroit Diesel service procedure 405-15 (2015)
documents.summary: Detroit's two-filter hard-start/no-start procedure uses measured cranking data rather than parts guessing. Key branches include confirming crank/cam synchronization status, checking whether actual rail pressure exceeds 150 bar (2176 psi), evaluating rail-pressure bleed-down, verifying the correct pressure-limiting valve (PLV), comparing desired versus actual rail pressure, checking for aerated fuel and evaluating the high-pressure pump. The OEM procedure also uses specialized priming/testing equipment and capped-rail testing for later branches. Diagnostic lesson: on an applicable Detroit two-filter engine, establish synchronization and actual/desired fuel pressure first; do not condemn injectors, PLV or the high-pressure pump without following the appropriate test branch.

documents.title: Volvo D11/D13/D16 regeneration SCR overtemperature error 38 software check
documents.authority: Volvo Trucks North America OEM Field Service Bulletin 284-061
documents.summary: Volvo FSB 284-061 states that certain Volvo vehicles built from January 1, 2013 through August 17, 2015 may show Premium Tech Tool error code 38 for SCR Overtemp during a PTT regeneration. The bulletin directs technicians to check engine ECU main software before troubleshooting; affected software levels require ECM and aftertreatment control module reprogramming. Diagnostic lesson: for an applicable D11/D13/D16 experiencing PTT regeneration error 38, verify software applicability before replacing aftertreatment hardware.

documents.title: Volvo D11/D13/D16 aftertreatment DTC software update awareness
documents.authority: Volvo Trucks North America OEM Field Service Bulletin 284-064
documents.summary: Volvo FSB 284-064 documents ECM/ACM software updates addressing a defined group of fuel, boost and aftertreatment DTCs including P2002, P0422, P226D, P249C, P208E, P2459, P24A4, P10FE, P226C, P249F, P24A0, P208A, P20CF and P205B on applicable D11/D13/D16 configurations. The bulletin instructs checking current ECM and ACM main software to determine required action. Diagnostic lesson: when one of these DTCs occurs on an applicable vehicle, check software level and bulletin applicability as part of diagnosis rather than automatically replacing the component named by the code.

documents.title: International A26 J1939-84 DM21 emissions recall applicability
documents.source: NHTSA archived International service procedure 23521R1, April 2024
documents.summary: International emissions recall 23521R1 applies only to designated HV, HX, LT and RH trucks built March 15, 2017 through July 3, 2022 with 2017-2021 model-year International A26 engines and marked eligible in the International Service Portal. The issue concerns J1939-84 Stationary Test DM21 parameters used for periodic smoke inspection program scanning and may cause OBD reporting inaccuracies. Diagnostic lesson: treat this as VIN/campaign-specific information and verify eligibility in the OEM service system; do not infer that every A26 J1939 complaint is covered by this recall.
